sentences.arabic: يُصَلِّي الْمُسْلِمُونَ خَمْسَ مَرَّاتٍ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ
sentences.transliteration: yusallee al-muslimoona khamsa marraatin kulla yawm

sentences.arabic: صِيَامُ رَمَضَانَ فَرْضٌ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ الْبَالِغِينَ
أَدَّى الْحَجَّ مَعَ وَالِدَيْهِ الْعَامَ الْمَاضِيَ
sentences.transliteration: addaa al-7ajja ma3a waalidayhi al-3aama al-maadee

sentences.arabic: الزَّكَاةُ تُسَاعِدُ الْأُسَرَ الْفَقِيرَةَ فِي مُجْتَمَعِنَا
sentences.transliteration: az-zakaatu tusaa3idu al-usara al-faqeerata fee mujtama3inaa

sentences.arabic: هَلْ هَذَا اللَّحْمُ حَلَالٌ؟ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَتَأَكَّدَ
sentences.transliteration: hal haadhaa al-la7mu 7alaal? ureedu an ata2akkad

sentences.arabic: زَارَ رَئِيسُ الْجُمْهُورِيَّةِ الْمُسْتَشْفَى الْجَدِيدَ أَمْسِ
sentences.transliteration: zaara ra2eesu al-jumhooriyyati al-mustashfaa al-jadeeda ams

sentences.arabic: مِنْ وَاجِبِ كُلِّ مُوَاطِنٍ أَنْ يَدْفَعَ الضَّرِيبَةَ
sentences.transliteration: min waajibi kulli muwaatinin an yadfa3a ad-dareeba

sentences.arabic: غَنَّى الْأَطْفَالُ النَّشِيدَ الْوَطَنِيَّ وَرَفَعُوا الْعَلَمَ
sentences.transliteration: ghannaa al-atfaalu an-nasheeda al-wataniyya wa rafa3oo al-3alam

sentences.arabic: أُحِبُّ التَّارِيخَ وَالْجُغْرَافِيَا أَكْثَرَ مِنَ الرِّيَاضِيَّاتِ
sentences.transliteration: u7ibbu at-taareekha wal-jughraafiyaa akthara mina ar-riyaadiyyaat

sentences.arabic: أَبِي يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَى الرَّادْيُو كُلَّ صَبَاحٍ
sentences.transliteration: abee yastami3u ilaa ar-raadyoo kulla sabaa7

sentences.arabic: الشِّعْرُ جُزْءٌ مُهِمٌّ مِنَ الثَّقَافَةِ الْعَرَبِيَّةِ
sentences.transliteration: ash-shi3ru juz2un muhimmun mina ath-thaqaafati al-3arabiyya
